description: Group savings and lending sustain for informal investment clubs (Chamas). Members contribute monthly, rotate payouts, and access pool-backed loans governed by DAO vote. Built on Colosso's financial infrastructure. THIS IS A COLOSSO PRODUCT — not part of Sustena core.
_colosso_note: This sustain is owned and governed by the Colosso product team. It extends the Colosso financial services fork and should not be confused with Sustena-core sustains (biashara, homestead, vyyb).

members.description: Chama member profiles keyed by member_id. Extends Colosso members with contribution history, trust score, and loan history.

rotation.description: Monthly payout rotation schedule. Sequential by join date.

schedule.description: Ordered list of rotation entries, one per period.

current_period.description: The period label currently in progress, e.g. '2026-05'.

pool.description: Shared savings pool balances and month-to-date flow.

loans.description: Active loans and full repayment history.

proposals.description: DAO governance proposal queue. Proposals may be financial (loan, expense) or structural (rule change, membership).

rules.description: Configurable chama governance rules. Set at sustain creation and amendable via structural proposals.

fine_amounts.description: Default fine amounts per reason in KES.

quorum_threshold.description: 60% of active members required for quorum

fines.description: Global fines ledger. Each record references a member and a fine reason.

meetings.description: Meeting log with attendance and minutes.

operators.name: chama.contribution.record
operators.description: Record a member's monthly chama contribution. Amount must be between min_contribution and max_contribution. Marks the contribution as on-time or late based on period deadline. Credits pool.balance and pool.total_contributed_mtd.

operators.name: chama.loan.request
operators.description: Create a loan proposal and route it to the Council (DAO) for approval. Amount must not exceed max_loan_ratio × pool.balance. Creates a proposal in the proposals queue with status IN_VOTING.

operators.name: chama.loan.disburse
operators.description: Disburse a Council-approved (PASSED) loan to the member. Debits pool.balance and creates a journal entry (Dr Loan Receivable / Cr Pool Balance).

operators.name: chama.loan.repay
operators.description: Record a loan repayment. Credits pool.balance. Marks loan REPAID when fully settled. Interest accrues at loan_interest_rate per month.

operators.name: chama.fine.record
operators.description: Record a fine against a member. Reason must be in rules.fine_reasons. Deducts from member balance. Appends to the global fines ledger.

operators.name: chama.meeting.schedule
operators.description: Schedule a chama meeting with date and agenda. Fires event.chama.meeting_scheduled.

operators.name: chama.dividend.calculate
operators.description: Compute per-member dividend split based on contribution balances. Returns a ResponseWidget with a dividend table. Read-only — no state mutations.

operators.name: chama.rotation.advance
operators.description: Advance the rotation schedule. Marks the current rotation entry as 'paid', transfers the rotation amount from pool.balance to the recipient, and creates a journal entry (Dr Pool Balance / Cr Member Disbursement). Fires event.chama.rotation.advanced.

_operatives_note: ChamaSecretaryOperative is the Orchie for this sustain — it proposes and executes but does not vote. It is the sole operative. There is no Council of peer operatives; DAO governance is performed by the human members.

invariants.description: Pool balance may never go negative. chama.loan.disburse and chama.rotation.advance enforce this.
No single loan may exceed 50% of the pool balance at origination.

invariants.expression: ALL contribution: amount >= rules.min_contribution AND amount <= rules.max_contribution
invariants.description: Contributions must fall between KES 500 and KES 50,000.
Only approved fine reasons may be recorded.

_access_levels.Level 0 (full access): secretary_id — can read all state, execute all operators, view all member records
_access_levels.Level 1 (own records only): member_ids — can view own contribution_history, loan_history, trust_score; cannot view other members' financial data

parameters.name: secretary_id
parameters.description: User ID of the Chama Secretary — the Orchie (Level 0 access). Has full read/write access to all state.

parameters.name: member_ids
parameters.description: List of member user IDs. Each member has Level 1 access (own records only).

parameters.name: chama_name
parameters.description: Display name of the Chama group (e.g. 'Kilimani Investment Club').

_notes.epic: Epic 1.5b — Chama sustain spec and ChamaSecretaryOperative. Colosso product.
_notes.secretary_role: ChamaSecretaryOperative is the Orchie — it proposes and executes but does NOT vote. Like Orchie in other sustains.
_notes.chama_cred: Trust scores (0.0–1.0) gate loan eligibility (minimum 0.4). Computed by ChamaSecretaryOperative.compute_trust_score().
